dialogues.speaker: Akahito's Likeness
dialogues.text: (This is Akahito's likeness, as done by Albedo.)

dialogues.speaker: Akahito's Likeness
dialogues.text: (Kazuha was the model for this picture, and it shows Akahito, his garments red in his trademark style, kneeling before the throne as he is being punished by the Shogun.)

dialogues.speaker: Akahito's Likeness
dialogues.text: ("Won't this image bring ill luck?" Someone asked, but neither the artist nor the model thought that this was a problem.)
